name: ConfirmDialog
title: Templates/Platform/Overlays/ConfirmDialog
summary: A small confirmation dialog: a title with a close button, one sentence of description, and a Cancel plus a confirm button whose kind says how destructive the outcome is (danger for a removal, primary for a commit). A removal such as Remove domain and a re-run such as Clear again render it, and the unsaved-changes guard shows the same shell when a dirty form is left (with a Save changes button when the form can be saved from there, as on a tabbed settings page). Built from `Dialog` with `DialogTrigger`, `DialogPortal`, `DialogOverlay`, `DialogContent`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription` and `DialogClose`, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter` and `Button`; closed by default behind a visible trigger.

variants.name: DiscardChanges
variants.summary: The unsaved-changes guard on a form that cannot be saved from the dialog: Keep editing returns to the form and the danger Discard changes leaves it.

variants.name: RunAgain
variants.summary: Run a cache-clear request again: a commit rather than a removal, so the confirm button is primary; the description counts what is cleared again and from which layer.

variants.name: SaveOrDiscard
variants.summary: The guard on a form that can be saved from the dialog, as when leaving a dirty settings tab: Discard changes drops to outlined and a primary Save changes saves before leaving.
